Container.Name: estia
Container.Overview: ESTIA is a real social network whose content stays on this machine: a local feed, profiles that reach other homes by public key, and end-to-end encrypted chats. No domain, no open ports, no developer servers. After the first start, read the setup code at the top of the container log and open the web UI to create the administrator.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, photos and the home's private key. Do not delete. The folder must belong to user 10001: chown -R 10001:10001 /mnt/user/appdata/estia

Config.Name: Language
Config.Description: Language of the home: en or it. Each member can choose their own.
